dedupe_keys.name: when2heat hourly national heat demand and heat pump cop time series for 28 european countries open power system data

description: When2Heat, published on the Open Power System Data platform and read on 2026-09-26, gives simulated hourly country-level heat demand and heat pump coefficient of performance (COP) time series for representing building heat pumps in power system models. Version 2023-07-27 covers 28 European countries from 2008 to 2022. Space and water heating demand is built from gas standard load profiles with reanalysis temperature and wind speed and population geodata, scaled to 1 TWh per year and, for 2008 to 2015, to annual heating statistics. COP series cover air, ground and groundwater sources with floor heating, radiator and water heating sinks, corrected with field measurements, for single-family, multi-family and commercial buildings. Files are CSV and XLSX in several layouts, plus SQLite, in 15-minute and 60-minute versions; processing is documented in Jupyter notebooks on GitHub. The data are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, and the page asks users to cite the 2019 Scientific Data paper by Ruhnau, Hirth and Praktiknjo and the 2023 update. Caveats: profiles are modelled, not metered, and the 2022 version swapped floor and radiator COP labels. Simulation uses are heat demand for district heating and heat pump capacity planning and sector-coupled optimisation. Related records: data-district-heating-standard-load-profiles gives German load profiles.
